answer_span_consistency.note: passed: accepted answers do not repeat the visible slot prefix

target_fidelity.note: Uses negative active past perfect continuous: “had not been sleeping.”

grammaticality.note: The completed sentence is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The cause-and-effect context is natural and coherent.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It directly practices one clearly specified target form.

determinacy.note: The verb and required form sufficiently determine the accepted responses.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt names the required form but does not display the completed target answer.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: No unrelated advanced grammar is needed to supply the blank.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external or specialist knowledge is required.
